per_question.answer: To avoid academic warning, an undergraduate needs to maintain a minimum cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 2.00. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 5. Academic Assessment > Academic Warning/Probation]

If a student's CGPA stays below 2.00 for three consecutive semesters, their admission to the University is automatically closed. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 5. Academic Assessment > Academic Warning/Probation]
A student can repeat a maximum of 2 courses in a summer semester, [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 6. Rules for Summer Semester].

Students earning an SGPA of 4.00 with at least 30 credit hours shall be included in a prestigious list called Rector’s List of Honors. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 7. Awards and the Honor System > Rector’s List of Honors]

If a teacher refers a case of cheating to the Department Disciplinary Committee, the maximum punishment of 'F' grade can be awarded in that course. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 8. Academic Honesty > Penalties for Academic Dishonesty]

A student is not allowed to submit an assignment written by a generative AI tool as their own work. This is because using Generative AI software to create assessments that are then claimed as the student's own work is considered academic misconduct. The requirement to declare, cite, reference, and reflect on the use of Generative AI is designed to prevent students from simply using the technology
Only 80% of the tuition fee is refunded if a student leaves within the first 15 days of classes, as stated in the Fee Refund Policy [fee-structure-page.html / Fee Refund Policy].

A faculty member must have been a full-time faculty member for more than 1 year to be eligible to start a technical start-up. [faculty-entrepreneurship-and-technical-start-ups-policy.pdf / 1. Purpose > Eligibility criteria for a technical start-up]

The Islamabad campus has a highly qualified, fully committed, and professionally stimulated faculty dedicated to academic excellence, with faculty members who excel in teaching competence and are adept at integrating the latest advancements in science and technology into their instruction. [annual-report-2023-24.pdf / ISLAMABAD, PAKISTAN > Islamabad Campus]

The deadline to withdraw from a course is the last day of the makeup week of every semester, as stated in section 4.25 of the Academic Rules Handbook, June 2026 edition, page 22. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 4. Registration > Withdrawal from a Course]
A regular semester is spread over 16 weeks of teaching, [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 1. Introduction > Academic Year].
Under the older 2023 academic rules, the deadline to withdraw from a course was the last day of classes. [undergraduate-academic-rules-aug-2023.pdf / 4. Registration > Withdrawal from a Course]

According to clause 1.21 of the academic rules, students are required to maintain 100% attendance in lectures, labs, tutorials, seminars, and discussions as prescribed by the course instructor. Absence of a maximum of 20% of the total attendance may be condoned by the HoD for genuine reasons, such as illness, etc. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 1. Introduction > Attendance Requirements]
The paper rechecking fee per course is Rs. 500, as stated in passage B [fee-structure-page.html / Miscellaneous Fees].
A B- grade is worth 2.67 grade points. [prospectus-2026-academic-rules-and-regulations.pdf / 6. Letter Grades and Grade Points]
